drafted_from: tool:rank-records-for-review's own row and the old kit's sample runs (kits/rank-records-for-review.json), read on origin/main bb8022539c
start_here: Say to your AI: "Put my records in the order I should review them, using this descriptor: {\"id\": \"sample.review\", \"source\": {\"address\": \"sample.review.records\"}, \"fields\": [{\"id\": \"primary\", \"path\": [\"title\"]}], \"standKind\": \"suggestion\", \"standView\": {\"record\": [\"record_ref\"]}}", with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"}."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the records and stands are the person's own rows, in whatever form their store keeps them.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:rank-records-for-review" with store and the descriptor. Ask the person which fields they want shown.
3. The first run makes the view once and proves the order on the example records; every attempt must come out as the prove step says, or the run stops and says which.
4. To accept or pass a row, build the request with tool:accept-or-pass-on-a-ranked-record and run workflow:keep-where-the-person-stands-on-a-record with its input, once per act.

worked_examples.title: Rank a sample list
worked_examples.ask: Put the sample review records in the order I should review them.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The example records r1 (rank 2), r2 (rank 1, agreed), r3 (no rank) and r4 (rank 1), with r4's stand taken back.
worked_examples.hands_back: rows [r2 (rank 1, stand "agree"), r4 (rank 1, stand null), r1 (rank 2, stand null), r3 (rank null, stand null)] and counts for four records.
